# MH-06 — Change a booking

**Business value:** 960

[Back to index](../README.md)

## User story

As a hiker

I want to change the date, time, party size, or requirements of my booking

So that the reservation reflects my current plans


## Notes

Changes are admitted within 48 hours from the date booked  .
Changes to party size are subject to the automatic verification of availability

<!-- Manual clarifications below this line are preserved on regeneration. -->

## Clarifications

When a hiker increases the party size and the party no longer fits at the tables already assigned, it should be treated as a new booking. The current seats are released and the tables are assigned again with the MH-01 rules. If there are not enough seats, the change is refused and the booking stays as it was.
